description: Main source file for a Flutter-based audiobook library app, defining models, state management, and UI components such as store, library, and player pages.

classes.name: Audiobook
classes.description: Represents an audiobook with metadata such as title, author, description, cover and audio URLs, and price.

classes.name: PlaybackData
classes.description: Stores playback progress for an audiobook, including last position.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: State management class handling audiobook library, playback, purchase logic, and persistent storage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes environment and runs the Flutter app with provider for app state.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes shared preferences, database, library, and playback data.

methods.name: _initDb
methods.description: Creates or opens the SQLite database with tables for library and playback data.

methods.name: _loadLibrary
methods.description: Loads user's purchased audiobook IDs from database.

methods.name: _saveToLibrary
methods.description: Adds an audiobook ID to the library in database and state.

methods.name: _loadPlayback
methods.description: Loads playback progress data from database.

methods.name: _savePlayback
methods.description: Saves current playback position for an audiobook to database.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Simulates purchasing an audiobook, adding it to library and showing confirmation.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of selected audiobook, restoring last position if available.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback of the current audiobook.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and clears current book.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks playback to a specified position.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Calculates playback progress as a percentage.

methods.name: getLastPosition
methods.description: Retrieves last saved playback position for a given book ID.

methods.name: _simulatePlayback
methods.description: Simulates playback by periodically updating position for demo purposes.
